scores.notes: Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown hair held by a dark band, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left facing the Caterpillar, right centre with the flamingo).

Alice in both has long wavy light-brown hair with a hairband, fair skin and rosy cheeks, yellow dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings; she looks a little taller and older on the right but hair and face agree.

Both show a mown grass croquet lawn enclosed by a pinkish brick garden wall with hedges and tall trees behind, card-soldier hoops and hedgehogs on the grass in soft daylight; right adds cypresses and clipped topiary from a different angle.

Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight strawberry-blonde to light-brown hair, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress, white pinafore and blue-striped stockings (left drinking from the bottle, right in the armchair at far right).

Alice in both is a fair girl with long straight light-brown to strawberry-blonde hair, in a yellow puff-sleeved dress with white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings (left grown tall in the court, right drinking from the bottle).
Alice in the armchair (left) and standing by the mushroom (right) is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and slim build, in the same yellow dress and pinafore.
Alice drinking in the hall (left) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair under a band, fair skin and the same face shape and build.

Alice leaning toward the King in court (left) and facing the Caterpillar (right) is a fair girl with long golden light-brown hair and the same face shape; hair is wavier and she looks a little older/taller on the left, but colour, length, skin and features agree.

Both show a walled garden lawn with clipped hedges in front of a low masonry wall, mixed trees with cypresses beyond, card-soldiers bent as hoops and hedgehogs on the grass; the right adds a foreground tree and a more furrowed lawn, compatible with another viewpoint.
Alice by the mushroom (left) and towering in court (right) is the same fair girl with long straight light-brown hair and similar face; she is larger on the right as the scene requires.
Alice by the mushroom (left) and drinking in the hall (right) is the same fair girl of about nine with long straight light-brown hair under a band, similar face and slim build.

Both have a cloth-covered tea table under a large tree, but the house behind differs: left is a cream stone/stucco cottage with steep shingled roof, dormers and a gabled doorway; right is a pale clapboard house with a long columned veranda. Alice's armchair also differs (green vs brown-pink).
Both show a grassy lawn enclosed by a red brick garden wall with leafy trees under a soft cloudy daytime sky, with croquet elements (card arches left, card soldiers, flamingos and hedgehogs right).
The house behind the table conflicts: left is a thatched half-timbered cottage with climbing roses, right is a grey clapboard house with a columned porch; table, tree and lawn are otherwise alike.
Alice in both is a girl of about the same age with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair, fair skin and a frowning face, in a yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Both have a long table on grass under a large spreading tree with a grey clapboard house with a porch behind; the left table is bare wood and the right has a white cloth and an armchair, but house, tree and lawn match.
The cat's coat colour conflicts: left is a grey tabby with dark grey stripes, right is a ginger/orange-brown tabby; both have the wide toothy grin and stripes.
Alice in both is a young girl with long straight light-brown hair, fair skin and the same round face in the yellow dress, white pinafore, blue sash and striped stockings.

Alice in the wing chair (left) and holding the flamingo (right) is the same young fair-skinned girl with long straight light-brown hair and round face, in the same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both have a cloth-covered table under a big oak, but the house is a stone cottage with a grey shingle roof, dormers and brick chimney on the left and a thatched, half-timbered cottage smothered in climbing roses on the right.

Alice is a girl of the same age with long light golden-brown hair held by a dark band, fair skin and the same round face in both; hair is a little wavier on the right but colour, length and age agree.

Alice is a young fair-skinned girl with long straight golden-brown hair, holding the flamingo on the left and sitting in the armchair on the right; hair colour and length, age and build agree despite the different expression.

Both have a clothed tea table on grass under a big tree, but the house behind differs: on the left a plain low tan clapboard cottage with a shingle roof and simple side porch close by, on the right a tall ornate grey Victorian house with decorative gable trim, an arched upper window and a centred porch with steps; Alice's seat also changes from a tan wing chair to a brown round-backed chair.

Alice is a young fair-skinned girl with long straight golden-brown hair, standing before the caterpillar on the left and seated in the wing chair on the right; hair colour and length, age and build agree.

Both show a grassy croquet lawn enclosed by a garden wall with large shade trees, hedges, card-figure hoops and hedgehogs in daylight; right is viewed from under a tree with more ridged turf, left from the open lawn, but the walled tree-ringed garden is compatible.

Alice in the armchair at the tea table (left) and drinking from the bottle in the hall (right): both a girl of about ten with long straight light-brown/strawberry-blonde hair held by a blue band, fair skin, round face, same yellow dress, white pinafore and striped stockings.

Both are a walled lawn under an overcast sky, but the enclosure conflicts: left has a red brick wall with open orchard-style deciduous trees and no hedges; right has a grey stone wall with tall dark cypress/conifers and formal clipped hedge walls. Wall material and planting style differ, so it does not read as the same garden.
Alice is a girl of the same age with long light-brown hair, black headband and fair skin in both; hair is wavier on the left and straighter on the right, but face and colouring match.

Alice has the same long light-brown hair with a dark headband, fair skin and girlish face in both (smiling with the flamingo left, frowning in court right); she is drawn a little taller on the right but identity cues match.
Alice is the same young girl with long straight light-brown hair, dark headband and fair skin in both (with the flamingo left, drinking from the bottle in the hall right).

Both show a walled garden lawn of ridged turf under a grey cloudy sky, ringed by tall trees and conifers with a garden wall behind and hedgehogs and card soldiers on the grass; the wall reads greyer on the left and redder on the right, a minor difference.
Alice holding the flamingo on the left and facing the Caterpillar on the right both have long straight light-brown hair, fair skin, the same girlish age and slight build.

Both show a long tea table on grass under a large spreading tree with a pale clapboard house with a porch close behind, in daylight; the table is bare wood on the left and covered by a stained cloth on the right, a prop difference rather than a different place.
The Cheshire Cat floating above the hedge on the left and lying on the branch on the right is the same grey-brown striped tabby with a broad toothy grin, yellow-green eyes and pointed ears.
